description:
Use this when you need an auditable Indonesia working-day count. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when cuti bersama is facultative for private employers and may be governed by each employer; ASN-specific implementation and local, sector, religious-optional and employer schedules are not inferred.
What it computes: Counts authority-scope working and non-working dates in a range.
Example user requests: Count Indonesia working days around National holiday. | Count Indonesia working days around Joint leave is separately labelled.
Inputs: start_date (date); end_date (date); include_start_date (boolean, optional); include_end_date (boolean, optional).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"start_date":"2026-01-01","end_date":"2026-01-01","include_start_date":true,"include_end_date":true}
Outputs: working_days, non_working_days, public_holidays_counted, territory, territory_name, day_type, holiday_names, holiday_kinds, holiday_details, calendar_scope, holiday_policy, substitute_day_policy, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: for each included date: working_days += status.is_working_day
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/indonesia-public-working-days-between with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/indonesia-public-working-days-between.md
name: count_id_working_days

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: Indonesia national holidays and joint-leave schedule published by the three-minister SKB

day_type.description: Deterministic classification: official_weekend, regular_workday, or the first published authority event kind.

holiday_details.description: Structured event details, including partial-day notes where published.

holiday_policy.description: National holidays and cuti bersama are preserved as separate event kinds; the result is an official government/employee schedule, not a universal private-employer closure calendar.

substitute_day_policy.description: No additional substitute-day, local-government, employer or sector rule is inferred beyond the published SKB dates.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Count Indonesia Working Days
